classification.difficultyReason: Translate exterior number-line regions into absolute-value inequalities, using midpoint, radius and endpoint inclusion.

content.prompt: Describe the following subsets of the number line in the form $|x-a|>r$ or $|x-a|\ge r$.

spec.description: Number line labelled −4 through 4, with exterior rays and open endpoints at −1 and 1.
spec.mathematics: The supplied set is x<−1 or x>1.
spec.answerVisibility: The supplied number-line set is visible; its requested absolute-value expression is answer-only.

answer.worked: The centre is $0$ and the boundary points are $1$ unit from it. Both endpoints are excluded, so $|x|>1$.

spec.description: Number line labelled −4 through 4, with exterior rays and filled endpoints at −3 and 1.
spec.mathematics: The supplied set is x≤−3 or x≥1.
spec.answerVisibility: The supplied number-line set is visible; its requested absolute-value expression is answer-only.

answer.worked: The midpoint of $-3$ and $1$ is $-1$, and each endpoint is $2$ units from it. The endpoints are included, so $|x+1|\ge2$.

spec.description: Number line labelled −4 through 4, with exterior rays and open endpoints at 0 and 3.
spec.mathematics: The supplied set is x<0 or x>3.
spec.answerVisibility: The supplied number-line set is visible; its requested absolute-value expression is answer-only.

answer.worked: The midpoint of $0$ and $3$ is $\frac32$, and each endpoint is $\frac32$ units from it. Both endpoints are excluded, so $\left|x-\frac32\right|>\frac32$.

spec.description: Number line labelled −4 through 4, with exterior rays and filled endpoints at 0 and 1.
spec.mathematics: The supplied set is x≤0 or x≥1.
spec.answerVisibility: The supplied number-line set is visible; its requested absolute-value expression is answer-only.

answer.worked: The midpoint of $0$ and $1$ is $\frac12$, and each endpoint is $\frac12$ unit from it. The endpoints are included, so $\left|x-\frac12\right|\ge\frac12$.

spec.description: Number line labelled −4 through 4, with rays in both directions and a single open endpoint at 1.
spec.mathematics: The supplied set contains every real number except 1.
spec.answerVisibility: The supplied number-line set is visible; its requested absolute-value expression is answer-only.

answer.worked: Every point except $1$ has positive distance from $1$, so $|x-1|>0$.
